links.outcome: LLM clinical task performance gap between Portuguese and English
links.effect: English advantage in diagnosis retrieval (+7.5-12.1 accuracy points across all models); advantage disappears in differential diagnosis, exam recommendation, and treatment planning, where CIs cross zero for most models.
links.quote: In diagnosis retrieval, English yields a consistent advantage across all models, with +7.5-12.1 accuracy points.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study introducing a bilingual Brazilian Portuguese-English clinical benchmark (ClinicalBr) and evaluating LLMs on clinical decision tasks across languages.
